messages.author: Mattia Cavallaro
messages.body:
Good morning everyone,
I'm working through the tutorial B5 about "Simulating the GFP". At the
very beginning, I have to eliminate water and add hydrogen atoms using
pdb4amber. The problem is that when I write the command and launch it,
the terminal give me the following error:
importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: pdb4amber
What can I do?
Thanks!
[
https://intranet.unisr.it/5xmille.jpg
]

messages.author: Bill Ross
messages.body:
Showing what you typed, a copy/paste of that and the following error to
see the details, would mean a lot.
My only guess from the importlib.blabla message is that you might be
running a shell script through a wrong interpreter.
Bill

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Aug 21, 2020, Mattia Cavallaro wrote:
>
>importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: pdb4amber
Are you using AmberTools20?  Have you applied update.5?  This should
solve the python problem here.
(Run "$AMBERHOME/update_amber --help" to get info on updates; or just
re-run "run_cmake")
[You can also visit github.com as Viktor suggested, but the above
*should* be simpler.]
...good luck....dac

messages.author: Hai Nguyen
messages.body:
On Fri, Aug 21, 2020 at 12:59 PM David A Case <david.case.rutgers.edu>
wrote:
> On Fri, Aug 21, 2020, Mattia Cavallaro wrote:
> >
> >importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: pdb4amber
>
>
> Are you using AmberTools20?  Have you applied update.5?  This should
> solve the python problem here.
>
>
Hi Dave,
The update.5 only helps if a user accepts amber to install Miniconda.
If a user uses his/her own python, there's still an issue.
For a quick fix, users can downgrade the version to setuptools==47.3.1
(just like update.5 does).
Hai
(Run "$AMBERHOME/update_amber --help" to get info on updates; or just
